outcome: Synthetic 30-day clinical deterioration; complete binary follow-up; no censoring
selection: 1200 synthetic records; 100 eligibility flags excluded before random split; 700 training / 400 internal hold-out
prediction_role: internal hold-out from same simulation distribution; not external validation
DCA_action: hypothetical escalation of monitoring; no proven clinical benefit
threshold_rationale: prespecified fictional scenario assuming harm/benefit tradeoff compatible with 5–40% risk; not a clinical recommendation
model_uncertainty: Point ROC/PR/DCA curves only; no model refit uncertainty. Calibration bins have conditional Wilson intervals.
